readout_other: tail-cuff blood pressure and heart rate; plasma EPI, NE, ANGII ELISA; c-fos immunofluorescence; HE and TUNEL staining; thermocouple brain temperature
direction_notes: US stimulation of the vlPAG enhanced c-fos density in vlPAG and CVLM and reduced SBP, HR and plasma EPI, NE and ANGII in SHRs; sham site had no effect.
safety_notes: HE and TUNEL staining showed no tissue damage or apoptosis after 1 h of stimulation; thermocouple temperature stayed 33.8-33.9 C at 0.4 MPa pulsed.

timing.protocol_description: 2 ms burst duration at 250 Hz PRF, sonication duration 200 ms, inter-stimulation interval 5 s. Total treatment time 20 min every day for one week.

source_quotes.n_subjects: We randomly divided 32 rats into 4 groups: WKY, Control, LIFU, and Sham (n = 8 per group).
source_quotes.exposures[0].fundamental_frequency_khz: The pulses were generated using a two-channel function generator (DG5072, Beijing RIGOL Technology Co., Ltd.; Beijing, P. R. China) and amplified by a radio frequency (RF) amplifier (25A250A, AR Europe; Bothell, WA, USA) before being sent to drive a focused transducer (diameter = 10 cm, radius-of-curvature = 8 cm, center frequency = 620 kilohertz (kHz)).

Peak rarefactional pressure 0.4 MPa measured with a rat skull in degassed water; recorded as in_situ measurement.
Sham SHRs sonicated below the motor cortex (real ultrasound, different site); Control SHRs and WKY rats unexposed.
Isoflurane during stimulation; BP measured in conscious rats.
